label: The universal origin bridge gives its self-edge sibling
meaning: Strength registration (not a new support for the root): the universal origin-to-exercise bridge, instantiated at a self-origin edge CausesOrigin x x, gives the self-edge sibling for the same frame and exercise vocabulary. The converse fails in the other-only control.

strong_version_needed.be90bb15-c2ce-44cd-ae2d-5ec6dc4c24c9: The universal bridge is the strong side of this strength registration, not a premise of a route step; only its self-edge instances are consumed.
